name: British Heart Foundation
summary: The UK's largest charitable funder of heart and circulatory research; also runs health information and support, CPR training and the national defibrillator network, and campaigns on policy. Its 651 shops help pay for it.

spending.source: https://www.bhf.org.uk/what-we-do/-/media/files/annual_report_and_accounts_2025-26.pdf (Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26, consolidated statement of financial activities p.109 and note 4 p.125: total charitable expenditure £150.4m of total expenditure £440.8m, year to 31 March 2026; excludes fundraising £46.2m and retail and trading £244.2m. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound, the site's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS). The year is labelled 2025, the calendar year most of the financial year falls in.)

lines.label: Research grants, implementation pilots and policy work
lines.source: https://www.bhf.org.uk/what-we-do/-/media/files/annual_report_and_accounts_2025-26.pdf (Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26, p. 109): research £96.2m plus policy and influencing (our judgment of 6% of health expenditure of £54.2m) and Healthcare Implementation Fund pilots (our judgment of 5%), £5.96m, year to 31 March 2026. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound, the site's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS). £102.16m = $134,595,800.
